verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a sandbox with test bank accounts that simulate the Open Banking experience. It authenticates with an Application ID and Secret, and offers client libraries only by generating them yourself from its OpenAPI spec (Java, Python, Node.js and more), not as maintained first-party SDKs. The failed probe of guessed OpenAPI paths does not contradict the docs, but no evidence shows the spec is easy to reach. Missing for 10: evidence of self-serve signup and API key issuance, a runnable quickstart reaching a first linked sandbox account, maintained official SDKs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of time-to-first-call.
